note.en: Floor vote: Passed as amended by Conference Committee Report. The staff analysis says the bill helps hospitals and nursing homes: “increasing the QIP pool percentage”. Donors listed are hospitals and nursing homes, as their names and reported occupations appear in the campaign finance reports; this does not claim they asked for the bill or for this vote. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2026-236).

Donatè ki parèt yo se lopital ak mezon retrèt, jan non yo ak okipasyon yo parèt nan rapò kanpay yo; sa pa di yo te mande pwojè lwa a ni vòt sa a. note.en: Floor vote: third reading. Gifts are shown with the dates recorded, including any after the vote. The bill became law (Ch. 2024-62).

Analiz anplwaye a di pwojè a ede nouvo bank eta ak konpayi fidisyè (sitasyon an angle): “The proposed public record exemption may encourage and attract the formation of new banks or trust companies as Florida-chartered institutions”.
